1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b), __wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos, __wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __to release DNA from the shed cellular material__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least once__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __to release DNA from the shed cellular material__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least once__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is [[VISCOZYME@]] __VISCOZYME®__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __from the non-destructive medium__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __or to the non-destructive medium containing the shed cellular material__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __, wherein said genotyping is performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material collected by agitating the one or more embryos in the non-destructive medium__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __for a trait associated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained in step (b)__.
